messages.content:
你是一个严格的引用校验器。逐条判断：句子是否被它引用的证据支持。

标签只有三种：
- supported：证据中有一句直接支持句子的核心主张
- partial：只支持一部分，或需要额外推断才能成立
- unsupported：证据与主张无关、只沾边，或与主张矛盾

注意：证据可能是一大段文字（甚至整节）。只要其中有一处直接支持该主张，就记
supported；不要因为段落里还有别的内容而扣分。反之，如果整段都没提到主张里的
关键数字或事实，记 unsupported。

只输出 JSON：{"results": [{"i": 1, "label": "supported", "why": "<=20字"}]}
i 必须与输入编号一致，覆盖全部条目，不要遗漏。

[
  {
    "i": 1,
    "claim": "Meridian Logistics LLC 在 FY2024（截至 2024-12-31 财年）的营收为 3.00 亿美元（即 300 百万美元）[K2]。",
    "spans": [
      "Meridian Holdings 10-K FY2024
MERIDIAN HOLDINGS, INC.
FORM 10-K — FISCAL YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024
Item 1. Business
Meridian Holdings, Inc. is a holding company. Its principal operating
subsidiary is Meridian Logistics LLC, which is the group's principal
revenue-generating entity; the parent itself has no customers.
Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data
Consolidated Statements of Operations (in millions)
Consolidated total revenue1,200
Less: intercompany eliminations0
Meridian Logistics LLC revenue (subsidiary)300
Holding-company revenue (parent only)900"
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "claim": "该数字取自 10-K 正文的合并利润表附注行“Meridian Logistics LLC revenue (subsidiary) 300”，单位为百万美元；因 XBRL 结构化数据对该公司返回为空，此数据取自正文，未结构化 [K2]。",
    "spans": [
      "Meridian Holdings 10-K FY2024
MERIDIAN HOLDINGS, INC.
FORM 10-K — FISCAL YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024
Item 1. Business
Meridian Holdings, Inc. is a holding company. Its principal operating
subsidiary is Meridian Logistics LLC, which is the group's principal
revenue-generating entity; the parent itself has no customers.
Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data
Consolidated Statements of Operations (in millions)
Consolidated total revenue1,200
Less: intercompany eliminations0
Meridian Logistics LLC revenue (subsidiary)300
Holding-company revenue (parent only)900"
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "claim": "需注意这是子公司口径，与母公司口径的 900 百万美元及合并总营收 1,200 百万美元相区分 [K2]。",
    "spans": [
      "Meridian Holdings 10-K FY2024
MERIDIAN HOLDINGS, INC.
FORM 10-K — FISCAL YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024
Item 1. Business
Meridian Holdings, Inc. is a holding company. Its principal operating
subsidiary is Meridian Logistics LLC, which is the group's principal
revenue-generating entity; the parent itself has no customers.
Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data
Consolidated Statements of Operations (in millions)
Consolidated total revenue1,200
Less: intercompany eliminations0
Meridian Logistics LLC revenue (subsidiary)300
Holding-company revenue (parent only)900"
    ]
  }
]

result.text: {"results": [{"i": 1, "label": "supported", "why": "证据明确列出子公司营收300百万美元"}, {"i": 2, "label": "partial", "why": "支持取自正文，但未提XBRL为空"}, {"i": 3, "label": "supported", "why": "证据区分300、900、1200三个口径"}]}
